dialogue.speaker: Tao
dialogue.text: The fire tonight... it's a quiet one. Not like the spirits in the Rift.

dialogue.speaker: Aya
dialogue.text: Fire has its own language, Tao. One of change. My ice is but a pause.

dialogue.speaker: Tao
dialogue.text: A pause? I like that. A moment to breathe before everything starts moving again.

dialogue.speaker: Aya
dialogue.text: Precisely. Perhaps together, we can find the rhythm between the pause and the motion.

dialogue.speaker: Aya
dialogue.text: Your movements have a certain... inevitability, Tao. Like the falling of ash.

dialogue.speaker: Tao
dialogue.text: It's the spark. It doesn't ask where it lands, it just... is. But your ice gives it a place to burn.

dialogue.speaker: Aya
dialogue.text: I anchor the moment. You light it up. It is a strange symmetry, but it holds.

dialogue.speaker: Tao
dialogue.text: Symmetry or not, the Nexus feels a little less cold when we're standing together.

dialogue.speaker: Tao
dialogue.text: The ghosts are quiet tonight. Even they can feel the end approaching.

dialogue.speaker: Aya
dialogue.text: Let them watch. My ice will be the foundation upon which your final flame shall burn.

dialogue.speaker: Tao
dialogue.text: And that flame will be the dawn for this shattered world. I'll stay by your side until the frost melts.

dialogue.speaker: Aya
dialogue.text: And I shall stay until the last ember fades into the starlight.

dialogue.speaker: Lulu
dialogue.text: The stars are particularly bright tonight, Rei. They look like they're trying to tell us something.

dialogue.speaker: Rei
dialogue.text: They speak of things long forgotten. Of debts that have outlasted the worlds that made them.

dialogue.speaker: Lulu
dialogue.text: Then perhaps we should dance for them. To show them that even in the dark, there is beauty.

dialogue.speaker: Rei
dialogue.text: A dance in the dark. It is a fragile thing. But... it is enough for tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Rei
dialogue.text: The tides here are heavy, Lulu. They carry the weight of many souls.

dialogue.speaker: Lulu
dialogue.text: I feel them. But water doesn't want to be heavy. It just wants to reach the sea.

dialogue.speaker: Rei
dialogue.text: Then I will be the riverbed. I will guide you through the jagged rocks until the path is clear.

dialogue.speaker: Lulu
dialogue.text: And I will be the current. We'll find the way together, Rei.

dialogue.speaker: Lulu
dialogue.text: The wind is different here. It smells of the open sky.

dialogue.speaker: Rei
dialogue.text: It is the smell of freedom. A debt finally being paid. My duty has never felt so light.

dialogue.speaker: Lulu
dialogue.text: Then let's make this the most beautiful dance of all. For the sky, and for everything beneath it.

dialogue.speaker: Rex
dialogue.text: Your creatures move with a grace that even kings might envy, Ria.

dialogue.speaker: Ria
dialogue.text: They are the memory of worlds that are no more, Rex. I am merely their vessel.

dialogue.speaker: Rex
dialogue.text: A heavy burden, being a vessel for an entire history. I know it well.

dialogue.speaker: Ria
dialogue.text: Then perhaps we can share the weight. Even a king needs someone to hold the line.

dialogue.speaker: Rex
dialogue.text: The shadows here are ancient, but your light... it cuts through them with ease.

dialogue.speaker: Ria
dialogue.text: The eidolons find strength in your presence, Rex. Your authority is an anchor for them.

dialogue.speaker: Rex
dialogue.text: If my crown can serve as a beacon for your magic, then I shall wear it with pride.

dialogue.speaker: Ria
dialogue.text: The sky ruins... they feel like home, in a way. A place where magic and kings once met.

dialogue.speaker: Rex
dialogue.text: And they meet here again. Let us show this world that true majesty never truly fades.

dialogue.speaker: Valka
dialogue.text: You lead with the heart of a soldier, but the eyes of someone who has lost much, Sera.

dialogue.speaker: Sera
dialogue.text: I lead for those who cannot. Losses are just the cost of keeping the line intact.

dialogue.speaker: Valka
dialogue.text: Duty is a sharp blade. It can protect, but it can also isolate. Do not lose yourself in the ranks.

dialogue.speaker: Sera
dialogue.text: As long as there is someone to stand next to me, I am never truly lost.

dialogue.speaker: Sera
dialogue.text: The walls are old, but our resolve is new. We hold here, Valka.

dialogue.speaker: Valka
dialogue.text: My wings will be your shield. I see the worthy in your heart, Commander.

dialogue.speaker: Sera
dialogue.text: And I see a guardian in you. Let us show them what happens when duty and divinity unite.

dialogue.speaker: Valka
dialogue.text: The void is the end of all things. But your spirit... it remains unbroken.

dialogue.speaker: Sera
dialogue.text: Because the duty isn't over yet. We have a world to bring back.

dialogue.speaker: Valka
dialogue.text: Then I shall be your wings until the very end. The judgment is passed, and you are found worthy.
